home.heroTitle: Piping systems engineered for every drop of India's growth.
home.heroSubtitle: Poddar Pipes designs and manufactures uPVC, CPVC, SWR, TANKS, UGD, and Agriculture piping systems for households, farms, industries, and infrastructure projects across India.
home.heroSlide_growth_desc: Poddar Pipes designs and manufactures uPVC, CPVC, SWR, TANKS, UGD, and Agriculture piping systems for households, farms, industries, and infrastructure projects across India.
home.heroSlide_decades_desc: Founded in 1975 by the Poddar family, every product we ship is engineered to Indian Standards, rigorously tested in-house, and quality-checked at every stage before it ever reaches a dealer's shelf.
home.heroSlide_infrastructure_desc: Our pipe systems are engineered for India's water transport and drainage infrastructure, built to withstand large-scale civic demands and perform reliably for decades of continuous use.
home.heroSlide_trust_desc: Our labs run continuous pressure, impact, and thermal testing against Indian Standards, so every batch leaving our facility meets the same benchmark, without exception, always.
home.heroSlide_irrigation_desc: Drip, sprinkler, and lift irrigation piping engineered for Indian farming conditions, helping farmers move water efficiently across fields, orchards, and plantations through every growing season.
home.overviewTitle: A 50-year legacy of excellence in plumbing.
home.overviewDesc: Founded in 1975 by the Poddar family — pioneers of PVC plumbing solutions and erstwhile owners of one of Asia's largest plumbing corporations — Poddar Pipes has grown into a full-range manufacturer of uPVC, CPVC, SWR, TANKS, UGD, and Agriculture piping systems. Every product we ship is engineered to Indian Standards and tested before it reaches a dealer's shelf.
home.overviewFacilityCaption: One production standard, engineered to Indian Standards — every batch, every plant.
home.whyTitle: Built on compliance, not just capacity.
home.whyDesc: We treat every product line as an engineering problem first — that discipline shows up in how our systems perform years after installation.
home.whyBisDesc: Our uPVC, CPVC, SWR, and UGD ranges are manufactured to relevant Indian Standards, with in-house batch testing for pressure, impact, and thermal performance before every dispatch.
home.whyWallDesc: Precision extrusion holds tolerance across every diameter we manufacture.
home.whyDealersDesc: Spanning every major state in India.
home.whySupportDesc: Technical guidance for large plumbing and infrastructure projects.
home.whyResponseDesc: Every dealer or technical inquiry, answered within a business day.
home.whySustainDesc: Reclaimed material streams reduce virgin resin use across our extrusion lines — without compromising pressure ratings.
home.categoriesTitle: Six product categories. One manufacturing standard.
home.categoriesDesc: From agricultural mains to hospital plumbing risers, every Poddar Pipes product line shares the same testing rigor and Indian Standard compliance.
home.categoriesUpvcDesc: IS 4985 pressure pipes for water supply, agriculture, and municipal networks.
home.categoriesCpvcDesc: Hot & cold water plumbing systems rated for continuous 82°C service.
home.categoriesSwrDesc: Soil, waste & rainwater drainage systems for residential buildings.
home.categoriesTanksDesc: Rotomoulded 2, 3 & 4-layer water storage tanks with anti-microbial protection.
home.categoriesUgdDesc: Underground drainage pipes for sewage and storm water networks.
home.categoriesAgriDesc: IS 4985 pressure pipes for water supply, plus drip irrigation lines.
home.industriesTitle: Built into the infrastructure of everyday life.
home.industriesDesc: From city water mains to greenhouse irrigation blocks, our systems operate quietly behind the industries that depend on reliable water movement.
home.mfgTitle: From resin to certified, dealer-ready product.
home.mfgDesc: Our facilities run a single production standard, so a pipe manufactured this year performs identically to the batch before it.
home.mfgStep0Desc: PVC, CPVC, and PE compounds are formulated and batch-tested before extrusion.
home.mfgStep1Desc: Automated lines hold wall-thickness tolerance across every diameter we make.
home.mfgStep2Desc: Every batch is pressure and impact tested against IS standards before release.
home.mfgStep3Desc: A 500+ dealer network keeps lead times short across every major state.
home.qualityTitle: Every batch tested before it reaches a dealer.
home.qualityDesc: Our labs run continuous pressure, impact, and thermal testing against Indian Standards — not spot checks.
home.qualityBatchDesc: Independent conformance to Indian Standards, verified before every dispatch.
home.sustainDesc: Pipes that last decades need replacing less often — that's the core of how we think about environmental impact.
home.sustainPillar0Desc: Reclaimed PVC streams reduce virgin resin use in select product lines.
home.sustainPillar1Desc: Our drip systems help farms cut water consumption significantly.
home.sustainPillar2Desc: Ongoing investment in lower-energy manufacturing processes.
home.blogsTitle: Guides, technical notes, and field stories.
home.ctaTitle: Tell us what you're building. We'll recommend the right piping system.
home.ctaDesc: Share your project scope and quantity requirements — our sales team will follow up within one business day with recommendations and a formal quote.
